newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia airport says 96 net profit up 33 pct.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia airport says 96 net profit up 33 pct.

text.p: Slovenia's main airport Aerodrom Ljubljana said on Friday its 1996 net profit rose 33.3 percent to 278.4 million tolars ($1.78 million).
"Our profit went up mostly due to declining costs. We plan to keep this year's profit and sales at about the same level as in 1996," chief executive Vinko Moze told Reuters.

He said 1996 sales increased to 3.3 billion tolars from 2.9 billion a year ago. The number of planes that landed at Ljubljana airport rose 1.7 percent to 18,100, while the number of passengers was up 4.7 percent to 668,000.

The airport is 55.69 percent state-owned, the rest is in the hands of Slovenian institutional and retail investors. The company's shares are not listed on the Ljubljana bourse. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
